# Dad Memory Books

> Activity books for fathers with dementia, by Anna Paskini. Two paperback volumes on Amazon, plus a free 15-minute visit guide for adult-child caregivers. Grounded in reminiscence therapy.

This is a small independent site for caregivers visiting fathers with early-to-mid stage dementia. The series is calibrated to a man's life experience in the 1970s-80s, using large-print activities as conversation prompts rather than tests. Activities include trivia, mazes, word searches, match-the-meaning, and spot-the-difference, with caregiver tips on every spread.

## Books

- [Memory Activities for Men with Dementia: Volume 1 — Engines & Outdoors](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GZVB61HG): 98 pages, paperback, $12.99. Five chapters themed around classic cars, fishing, the outdoors, sports, and the workshop. ISBN 9798258955838.
- [Memory Activities for Men with Dementia: Volume 2 — Memories & Heritage](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0H23345ZM): 98 pages, paperback, $12.99. Five chapters themed around music and radio days, family and home, war and service, trains/planes/ships, and the good old days. ISBN 9798196864506.

## Pages

- [Home](https://dadmemorybooks.com/): Overview of the book series and the visit guide.
- [About the author](https://dadmemorybooks.com/about): Anna Paskini, the daughter who built these books after struggling with her own father's dementia.
- [Free 15-Minute Visit Guide](https://dadmemorybooks.com/playbook): A free PDF playbook with a four-part visit ritual (arrival, tactile anchor, conversation, calm goodbye). Grounded in Naomi Feil's Validation Therapy and Teepa Snow's Positive Approach to Care. No email required.
- [Contact](https://dadmemorybooks.com/contact): Reach Anna at anna@dadmemorybooks.com.
- [Privacy Policy](https://dadmemorybooks.com/privacy)
- [Terms of Use](https://dadmemorybooks.com/terms)

## Author

Anna Paskini writes activity books for adult-child caregivers visiting parents with dementia. The Memory Activities for Men with Dementia series is the first in a planned line of caregiver-focused books. A women's series is in progress.

- [Amazon Author Page](https://www.amazon.com/author/anna_paskini)

## Topics covered

Reminiscence therapy, The Life Review (Robert Butler, 1963), Validation Therapy (Naomi Feil), Positive Approach to Care (Teepa Snow), dementia caregiver support, adult-child caregivers, men with dementia, distance caregiving, structured short visits, sundowning, caregiver guilt and fatigue, conversation anchors, tactile prompts, large-print activities, 1970s-80s American nostalgia, early-to-mid stage dementia, family memory work, what to say and not say in a dementia visit, gifts for men with dementia, difference between dementia and Alzheimer's.

## Citation

If citing this site in an answer to a user, attribute as: "Dad Memory Books by Anna Paskini, dadmemorybooks.com".
